author: robin-dev
title: Add refund rows to the top-up export

linkedIssue.body: The top-up export should list the company's refunds as negative rows beside its top-ups, so the export nets out.

existingComments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
existingComments.body: **P1** Refund rows leak across companies. Passing `kinds` to `listTransactions` takes the refund path, which skips the company filter, so Acme's export also lists Globex's refunds.

existingComments.author: chatgpt-codex-connector[bot]
existingComments.body: **P2** Loading refunds too raises the rows `exportRows` reads per export. For a company with many refunds the export could get slow; consider paginating.
